fix_verification.issue: SSE connections timing out during research due to race condition - frontend opens SSE after HTTP response but backend emits events immediately
fix_verification.fix_description: Added 100ms delay before emitting first event to allow SSE connection to establish
fix_verification.before_fix_behavior: Events missed, connection appeared dead, timeout at 30-60s
fix_verification.after_fix_behavior: All events received, connection stable for 2+ minutes
